```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

baltimore_data <- homicides %>% 
  filter(city == "Baltimore") %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(reported_date),
         season = if_else(month(date) >= 5 & month(date) <= 10,
                          "Summer", "Winter"))

baltimore_data
```
